Fixed 2026-11-16 (lulcw 0.7.1): five ranges the definitions already stated (xsd:date for coverageStart, coverageEnd, releaseDate, retrievalDate; Piezometer for targetEntity); the count falls only from 78 to 77 because P11 counts a missing domain too, and the four dates are shared by series and releases. The others are deliberate: a property shared by several classes (confidence, codeVersion, releaseDate, bssId...) gets no domain, and a property whose values are a union (a unit or a unit group; a piezometer or a facility; any driver entity) gets no range, because rdfs:domain and rdfs:range infer types instead of checking them; usage is checked by the SHACL shapes (ontology/shapes/lulcw-shapes.ttl) and by the graph's tests against the source tables.

Inverses are not declared on purpose: every query traverses a relation in both directions in SPARQL, and inverse properties would double the vocabulary and the stored triples without adding information.
OOPS! names lulcw:WaterUse without detail; every lulcw local name is CamelCase (classes upper, properties lower; checked by this script), so no naming convention is mixed.

lulcw:overlies is directional (the upper unit overlies the lower one), so not symmetric, and it is deliberately not transitive: direct contacts and indirect orderings are separate relations, each witnessed by its BD LISA polygon (task 12.6).
